name: Hürth (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Hürth (an eagle and a black cross above a red cogwheel).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne of 24 February 1984 the city of Hürth was granted the right to bear a flag, described as red and white striped 1:1 with the city arms shifted towards the staff.

features.role: Hürth arms — eagle, cross and cogwheel
